title: Faculty can view the student activity history
description: A faculty user can open a student record, access the activity tab, and see the chronological activity table with the expected columns and campus content entries.

steps.description: Navigate to /web/login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the Students list
Open the student record for Alumno E2E Activity
Open the activity tab
Verify the activity table is displayed
Verify the table shows the expected activity columns and a row containing content activity

title: Faculty can export the student activity history as CSV
description: A faculty user clicks Exportar CSV on the Actividad tab and an Odoo modal wizard opens showing a ready CSV filename (actividad_*.csv). Success is the visible wizard/filename, NOT a browser download event and NOT an input[type=file] upload control.

steps.description: Navigate to /web/login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the Students list
Open the student record for Alumno E2E Activity
Open the activity tab named Actividad
Click the button labeled Exportar CSV once
Verify a modal/dialog appears with title or text Exportar actividad CSV, or alert text Archivo CSV listo para descargar
Verify the modal shows a filename containing actividad_ and ending with .csv (plain text or Binary download link). Do NOT look for input[type=file] or accept=text/csv.
